Run Moran, Laplacian/Fourier and rewiring tests per cell type

Source: R/leviSingleCellStatistics.R
leviSingleCellTopologyInference.Rd

Takes the moderated t-statistics stored in a [leviSingleCellTFCEInference()] result and applies [leviGraphMoran()], [leviGraphSpectrum()] and [leviGraphRewiringInference()] to every cell type.

leviSingleCellTopologyInference(
  single_cell_tfce,
  networkCoordinatesInput,
  networkInteractionsInput = NA,
  fileTypeInput = "dat",
  threshold = 2,
  n_perm = 999L,
  seed = NULL,
  BPPARAM = SerialParam()
)

Arguments

single_cell_tfce

Result of [leviSingleCellTFCEInference()]; the `T` column of every cell-type table supplies the gene scores.

networkCoordinatesInput, networkInteractionsInput, fileTypeInput

LEVI network inputs: node coordinates, optional interactions and the file type accepted by [levi()].

threshold

Absolute t-statistic threshold for cluster formation in the rewiring test.

n_perm

Number of node-label permutations or rewired networks used by each topology test.

seed

Optional RNG seed.

BPPARAM

A [BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam] object controlling how the permutations are evaluated. The default runs them serially.

Value

A named list of topology-test results, one entry for each cell type.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("limma", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  net <- system.file("extdata", "hub_network.dat", package = "levi")
  genes <- c("HUB", paste0("N", 1:8))
  donor <- rep(paste0("d", 1:6), each = 4)
  cell_type <- rep(rep(c("A", "B"), each = 2), 6)
  counts <- matrix(rpois(length(genes) * length(donor), 10), length(genes),
    dimnames = list(genes, NULL))
  condition <- c(d1 = "C", d2 = "C", d3 = "C", d4 = "T", d5 = "T", d6 = "T")
  tfce <- leviSingleCellTFCEInference(counts, donor, cell_type, condition,
    net, min_cells = 2, seed = 1)
  topology <- leviSingleCellTopologyInference(tfce, net, threshold = 1,
    n_perm = 19, seed = 1)
  topology$A$moran$global
}
#>         MoranI P
#> 1 -0.001428025 1
